why: The striped triangle inside the circle turns 90 degrees clockwise each time: up, right, down, left. After left it comes back to pointing up. Option 4 shows the triangle pointing up. Option 1 (pointing right) would be the second figure again.
trick: For a turning arrow or triangle, say the directions aloud: up, right, down, left, up.
